email.subject: RFQ: sea freight Haiphong to Rotterdam
email.body_text:
Hello,

Quayside Freight is tendering for a sea freight partner on the Haiphong–Rotterdam lane, roughly 40 TEU a month. Are you able to quote? Tender closes in three weeks.

Regards,
Tom Brennan
